description:
Choi Geonwoo has been secretly in love with Yoon Bona since childhood. As it becomes harder for him to hide his feelings, he decides to confess to Bona right before his military enlistment, planning to run away if she rejects him… Unexpectedly, however, Bona accepts Geonwoo’s feelings. Before they know it, his enlistment day is approaching. While Bona is thinking about preparing a special event for Geonwoo… She remembers how he always used to call her his “bunny-like girlfriend,” and ends up buying a “bunny girl costume.” 

But when Bona puts on the outfit, real rabbit ears and a tail appear on her body. And in the instruction manual, which she checks too late, there is a hint-like note left behind: rabbits have a strong sexual drive…
